name: Edited file pinned by an untouched test
definition: A plan edits files or behavior that a test elsewhere pins, with no task that updates or runs that test.
question_template: Open the referencing file the plan never names. Does it pin the text or behavior being changed? Does any task update or run it?
severity_guidance: Blocking when the pinned test fails after the planned change and no task updates or runs it; minor when it pins only a comment.
known_weakness: Dependents that refer to the file only by an indirect name.
